question: True or false: Pearl Milling Company, which replaced the Aunt Jemima brand in 2021, was a name newly invented by marketers?
answer: False. It was the name of the mill in St. Joseph, Missouri, behind the self-rising pancake mix of 1889. Retiring the Aunt Jemima image, a racial caricature, PepsiCo's Quaker Oats reached into its own history. The newest name on the box was the oldest one.
move: Before calling a new name invented, look in the company's own past.
trap: New corporate names sound focus-grouped, so this one seems invented too.
reference: PepsiCo, Aunt Jemima Brand to Change Name to Pearl Milling Company, press release, 9 February 2021
